description: List the sections in a OneNote notebook (Microsoft 365). Pass a notebook_id to list that notebook's sections, or omit it to list all sections across every notebook. Returns each section's id, display name, and created/last-modified times. Use to navigate a user's OneNote notes before listing pages.

notebook_id.description: Optional OneNote notebook ID (from list_notebooks). If omitted, returns sections across all notebooks.

name: list_sections
title: List Sections
